flavor: The streets are quiet tonight. Just cats stuck in trees.
You swing a full loop around Queens and nothing's going down.
A slow night. You catch your breath on a water tower.
Dead quiet. Even the usual troublemakers are staying in.
You web-swing past a wedding on a rooftop. Nice for them.
A whole patrol and the biggest crime is someone's double-parked.
You snap a nice skyline shot from a rooftop on the way back.
A decent sunset shot over the Chrysler Building.
You catch the Manhattan Bridge lit up just right.
A perfect shot of the Empire State Building through the fog.
You catch some kids flying a kite off a fire escape. Cute, sellable.
The Statue of Liberty at golden hour — JJJ's actually going to like this one.
You stop a mugging in an alley off 5th.
A break-in at a bodega — you swing in just in time.
Some idiot tries to snatch a purse right in front of you.
A car alarm won't stop going off and you go check it out.
Some kid's about to get jumped outside a bodega.
Somebody's trying to boost a bike with bolt cutters in broad daylight.
A break-in gone loud at a pawn shop — this guy's not backing down.
Somebody's running a protection racket on 9th, and they don't scare easy.
A car-jacking in progress, and this one's got a knife on him.
A small gang's cornered someone in a parking garage.
An armed robbery at a corner store, and the guy's jumpy.
A shakedown crew leaning on a shop owner two blocks over.
A full-blown brawl with a low-level enforcer downtown.
Somebody's boosting a truck full of Oscorp hardware and it goes loud fast.
A hostage situation at a bank on 42nd — this one's bad.
Gunfire near Times Square — you're the first one there.
Someone's using tech way above street-level for a heist.
A whole block's worth of trouble, and it's all pointed at you now.

donations.flavor: A bystander presses a folded bill into your hand before you can swing off.
A small thank-you check shows up from the city council for your help downtown.

hazards.flavor: You landed wrong on that last swing. A trip to urgent care sets you back.
Somewhere between webbing up and changing in an alley, some cash slipped out of your pocket.
You almost forgot — MJ's birthday is this week. Better grab something good.
Aunt May's had a rough week. You swing by with flowers on the way home.
